card.name: Digits inside long numbers
card.fires_on: A single digit in the middle of a multi-digit number, such as a year, altitude, statistic, count or ID, usually just before the final digits.

modes.label: Middle digit of a number
modes.description: One digit inside a figure like an altitude, count or year, with more digits following.

modes.label: Decimal or statistic digit
modes.description: A digit within a statistical value or long decimal.

modes.label: Unit after a number
modes.description: The unit following a number in a dose ratio.
